item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 28/Oct/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong northeast monsoon will affect the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. Meanwhile, an upper-air disturbance will bring showers to Guangdong. With the upper-air disturbance departing, the dry northeast monsoon will bring generally fine weather to Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week. Temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large over inland areas.

R.H. range: 75 - 90 per Cent
